name: Call Of Duty Black Ops 6 As Val
designation: AS Val 9x39mm integrally suppressed assault rifle
axis_orientation: muzzle/nose/bow is at the +1 end of the axis
operating_principle: The AS Val is a gas-operated, long-stroke piston system with a rotating bolt, chambered for the 9x39mm subsonic cartridge. It uses a modified Kalashnikov action and has an integral suppressor.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel and the integral suppressor.
The gas system includes the gas block, gas tube, and piston, which operate the rotating bolt.
The bolt and bolt carrier group are responsible for chambering and extracting the cartridge.
The receiver and dust cover house the bolt and bolt carrier group, and provide a mounting point for the barrel and gas system.
The fire control group includes the trigger, hammer, and sear, which control the firing of the rifle.
The feed system consists of the magazine and mag catch, which supply the rifle with ammunition.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and handguard, which provide a comfortable and stable platform for the shooter.
The sights include the iron sights and any optional optical sights, which provide aiming points for the shooter.
